story.title: The Story of Martha
paragraphs_en: Martha was a 11-year-old girl. Marathon running was her passion. She joined her school's marathon club and succeeded in all her marathon contests and made everyone proud. One fine day, while Martha was eating her breakfast, her mom leaped into the dinning room and hugged Martha. She couldn't understand anything and was confused. Then, her mom said that Martha was selected for the district level Marathon competition!! Martha was so happy. She decided to practice very hard for the competition. Then, she called her cousin and best friend, Zoe, who studied in the same school as Martha, and told her about the news. Zoe was also a marathon runner but wasn't as good as Martha. In fact, Zoe envied Martha. But the news of Martha being selected for the district level made Zoe's envy turn into jealousy.

As soon as Martha hung up the phone, evil thoughts began flooding Zoe's mind. She was thinking of a plan to not let Martha participate. That is when Zoe's older brother, Zen, interrupted her thoughts. He was curious of what kept his sister so lost in thought. Zoe opened up and told him everything. Zen, who was unlike his jealous sister, felt happy for Martha. But, he didn't say anything about it to Zoe. He had a plan in his mind. He would listen to Zoe's evil ideas and inform it to Martha and both of them would figure out a way to stop her. Zoe said that she would somehow injure Martha's leg so that Martha couldn't play and since she is the second best marathon runner, she would be selected. Zen had his own plans.

Soon, Zen was walking to Martha's house to tell her about Zoe's evil plan. Martha, on the other hand, refused to believe him. She trusted Zoe. Even though Zen told her everything, she still refused to believe. The sun was beginning to set and Zen was walking back home, thinking what he could do to save his cousin sister. Soon, he came up with a plan. Time flew and it was finally one day before Martha's competition. Everything was going as per the plan for all the three of them. Martha practiced very hard, Zoe was working on executing her plan and Zen was setting up some costumes for his plan. The sun set that day. Martha and her parents went out that night as Zoe had invited all of them for a family dinner at her home.

Everybody in the family was present at Zoe's house. Zoe sat next to Martha during dinner time as usual. They were casually chatting but Martha didn't mention anything about Zen's warning of Zoe's evil plans. That night, everybody's attention was on Martha, which made Zoe even more jealous. So, she set out early to execute her plan. She went to the nearby forest and examined for any dangerous animals and then switched off the lights in the street so that Martha wouldn't have a clue of where Zoe was leading her to. She then spotted Martha in the corner of the room, standing alone. She invited Martha for a walk, which was actually a plan for injuring Martha's leg.

Although everything was going according the plan, Zoe smelled something fishy about Martha. She seemed, well, different. But Zoe didn't have any time for investigations. She carried on. She was talking with Martha and walked to the dark forest. She immediately recognized the trap in the grass that she had set for Martha and walked towards it with Martha by her side. On the other hand, the bright and always curious Martha didn't have any suspicions, which was unusual. Zoe slowly led Martha into the trap and suddenly, Martha slipped and fell with a thud. Zoe smiled on the inside but pretended she was sorry on the outside. She helped Martha get up and examined the wound. It was a pretty big wound, just as she expected and took her home.

Soon, Zoe was back home, screaming that Martha was hurt. Everybody looked shocked, instead of immediately rushing and helping her. They said that Martha was standing right behind them. Then, Martha appeared out of the crowd and waved at Zoe telling her that she was right there for the past thirty minutes and that it was her brother Zen, who was hurt. Zoe was terrified. She looked at the face only to see her older brother winking at her ans he whispered, "Your evil plans won't work as long as I am here". On seeing Zen wounded, everybody rushed and took him to the doctor for medical aid, while Martha and her family left home as she had to wake up early for the following day's contest. The next morning, Martha woke early and was surprised to get a phone call from Zen telling her that what he said earlier was true and that he had gone as Martha the previous night to trick Zoe.

The next morning, Martha woke early and was surprised to get a phone call from Zen telling her that what he said earlier was true and that he had gone as Martha the previous night to trick Zoe. Martha thanked him with a whole heart and he said that it was a brother's duty to protect his sister from harmful people, even if it was against his own sister. Then finally, it was time for the marathon to begin. All the students from Martha's school was present to cheer her, except for Zoe, who decided to stay home after what had happened the previous night. Martha ran confidently that she would get a prize and yes! She did get a prize! The first prize!! Everyone felt so happy for her, even Zoe, after she heard that it was her sister and best friend who had won. She immediately went to the arena to apologize after realizing what a horrible mistake she had done. Martha accepted her apology and both the sisters lived happily ever after.

She immediately went to the arena to apologize after realizing what a horrible mistake she had done and told Martha everything and also that she had learned her lesson from Zen, who scolded her heavily the previous night. Martha accepted her apology and said that she already knew about Zoe's plans but still trusted her. Zoe felt even more sad after hearing how much Martha trusted her. She swore to never repeat this mistake and Martha immediately hugged her. Both the sisters then lived happily ever after.

Many years later, a little girl named Ruby, was reading a story book. Her mom came in and asked her what she was reading. Ruby replied, "Mom, do you know, a girl named Martha who lives in our country won the gold medal for marathon running for six times in the Olympics? I am reading a book about her. Did you know that her sister Zoe had won the silver medal every time Martha won the gold? I also wanna become like Martha and one day and then people will publish stories about me!!" This way, everyone knew about Martha, the Marathon Champion and she became a role model for everybody. They also knew about Zoe, the silver medalist in marathon running, who was Martha's best friend and a great sister till the very end of her life. THE END

items.text_en: Martha was a 11-year-old girl.
Marathon running was her passion.
She joined her school's marathon club and succeeded in all her marathon contests and made everyone proud.
One fine day, while Martha was eating her breakfast, her mom leaped into the dinning room and hugged Martha.
She couldn't understand anything and was confused.
Then, her mom said that Martha was selected for the district level Marathon competition!!
Martha was so happy.
She decided to practice very hard for the competition.
Then, she called her cousin and best friend, Zoe, who studied in the same school as Martha, and told her about the news.
Zoe was also a marathon runner but wasn't as good as Martha.
In fact, Zoe envied Martha.
But the news of Martha being selected for the district level made Zoe's envy turn into jealousy.
As soon as Martha hung up the phone, evil thoughts began flooding Zoe's mind.
She was thinking of a plan to not let Martha participate.
That is when Zoe's older brother, Zen, interrupted her thoughts.
He was curious of what kept his sister so lost in thought.
Zoe opened up and told him everything.
Zen, who was unlike his jealous sister, felt happy for Martha.
But, he didn't say anything about it to Zoe.
He had a plan in his mind.
He would listen to Zoe's evil ideas and inform it to Martha and both of them would figure out a way to stop her.
Zoe said that she would somehow injure Martha's leg so that Martha couldn't play and since she is the second best marathon runner, she would be selected.
Zen had his own plans.
Soon, Zen was walking to Martha's house to tell her about Zoe's evil plan.
Martha, on the other hand, refused to believe him.
She trusted Zoe.
Even though Zen told her everything, she still refused to believe.
The sun was beginning to set and Zen was walking back home, thinking what he could do to save his cousin sister.
Soon, he came up with a plan.
Time flew and it was finally one day before Martha's competition.
Everything was going as per the plan for all the three of them.
Martha practiced very hard, Zoe was working on executing her plan and Zen was setting up some costumes for his plan.
The sun set that day.
Martha and her parents went out that night as Zoe had invited all of them for a family dinner at her home.
Everybody in the family was present at Zoe's house.
Zoe sat next to Martha during dinner time as usual.
They were casually chatting but Martha didn't mention anything about Zen's warning of Zoe's evil plans.
That night, everybody's attention was on Martha, which made Zoe even more jealous.
So, she set out early to execute her plan.
She went to the nearby forest and examined for any dangerous animals and then switched off the lights in the street so that Martha wouldn't have a clue of where Zoe was leading her to.
She then spotted Martha in the corner of the room, standing alone.
She invited Martha for a walk, which was actually a plan for injuring Martha's leg.
Although everything was going according the plan, Zoe smelled something fishy about Martha.
She seemed, well, different.
But Zoe didn't have any time for investigations.
She carried on.
She was talking with Martha and walked to the dark forest.
She immediately recognized the trap in the grass that she had set for Martha and walked towards it with Martha by her side.
On the other hand, the bright and always curious Martha didn't have any suspicions, which was unusual.
Zoe slowly led Martha into the trap and suddenly, Martha slipped and fell with a thud.
Zoe smiled on the inside but pretended she was sorry on the outside.
She helped Martha get up and examined the wound.
It was a pretty big wound, just as she expected and took her home.
Soon, Zoe was back home, screaming that Martha was hurt.
Everybody looked shocked, instead of immediately rushing and helping her.
They said that Martha was standing right behind them.
Then, Martha appeared out of the crowd and waved at Zoe telling her that she was right there for the past thirty minutes and that it was her brother Zen, who was hurt.
Zoe was terrified.
She looked at the face only to see her older brother winking at her ans he whispered, "Your evil plans won't work as long as I am here".
On seeing Zen wounded, everybody rushed and took him to the doctor for medical aid, while Martha and her family left home as she had to wake up early for the following day's contest.
The next morning, Martha woke early and was surprised to get a phone call from Zen telling her that what he said earlier was true and that he had gone as Martha the previous night to trick Zoe.
The next morning, Martha woke early and was surprised to get a phone call from Zen telling her that what he said earlier was true and that he had gone as Martha the previous night to trick Zoe.
Martha thanked him with a whole heart and he said that it was a brother's duty to protect his sister from harmful people, even if it was against his own sister.
Then finally, it was time for the marathon to begin.
All the students from Martha's school was present to cheer her, except for Zoe, who decided to stay home after what had happened the previous night.
Martha ran confidently that she would get a prize and yes!
She did get a prize!
The first prize!!
Everyone felt so happy for her, even Zoe, after she heard that it was her sister and best friend who had won.
She immediately went to the arena to apologize after realizing what a horrible mistake she had done.
Martha accepted her apology and both the sisters lived happily ever after.

She immediately went to the arena to apologize after realizing what a horrible mistake she had done and told Martha everything and also that she had learned her lesson from Zen, who scolded her heavily the previous night.
Martha accepted her apology and said that she already knew about Zoe's plans but still trusted her.
Zoe felt even more sad after hearing how much Martha trusted her.
She swore to never repeat this mistake and Martha immediately hugged her.
Both the sisters then lived happily ever after.
Many years later, a little girl named Ruby, was reading a story book.
Her mom came in and asked her what she was reading.
Ruby replied, "Mom, do you know, a girl named Martha who lives in our country won the gold medal for marathon running for six times in the Olympics?
I am reading a book about her.
Did you know that her sister Zoe had won the silver medal every time Martha won the gold?
I also wanna become like Martha and one day and then people will publish stories about me!!" This way, everyone knew about Martha, the Marathon Champion and she became a role model for everybody.
They also knew about Zoe, the silver medalist in marathon running, who was Martha's best friend and a great sister till the very end of her life. THE END
